meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤把 Resend 适配器复制进 src/channels、在通道入口注册、安装固定版本依赖,再跑构建和单测;随后把 Resend 密钥与发件信息写入 .env,将你的邮箱设为 owner,并让指定 agent 回复你的邮件。
howto.when: 当你说要给项目添加 Resend 邮件通道(通过 Chat SDK)、把邮件接入 NanoClaw,或要求按此技能接入时触发。

say.text: 给项目接入 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 它会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖,然后跑构建和测试。

say.text: 把 Resend 密钥和发件地址写入 .env
say.note: 会读取你粘贴的值,不覆盖已填内容。

say.text: 把我的邮箱设为 owner,并让指定 agent 回信
say.note: 会执行 wiring 命令并发送欢迎邮件。

howto.what_en: It copies the Resend adapter into src/channels, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, and runs the build and tests. Then it writes the Resend API key and sender info into .env, sets your email as owner, and lets the chosen agent answer your email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Resend email channel via Chat SDK, connect email to NanoClaw, or otherwise invoke this skill.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to the project.
say_en.note: Copies, registers, installs the dependency, runs build/tests.

say_en.text: Write the Resend API key and sender address into .env.
say_en.note: It asks for values and does not overwrite existing entries.

say_en.text: Set my email as owner and have the chosen agent reply.
say_en.note: It wires the account and sends a hello email.
